soundness_assessment: The source parser pins the complete literal program, rejects unparsed row content, visits each decoder node exactly once, and requires the full node/leaf census. All generated guarded edges use the consumed leaf path; carry retains cleared zeros, drop consumes the stated number of matching symbols, and decode adds zeros while rejecting a discarded nonzero suffix.

The product domain uses nonempty masks over zero, one and at-least-two. Its increment and guarded decrement images contain exactly the possible category outcomes; unchanged registers retain their masks. Initial inclusion plus every feasible successor inclusion supports ordinary induction for all execution lengths and register magnitudes.
The product initial family is N,A,D,X,Y,L arbitrary naturals and T=W=H=0. It is strictly broader than the relational initial family.

The relational bitset encodes every admitted category vector in base3. Width/padding checks exclude invalid codes. Increment changes only a digit below2; positive decrement of category2 branches to both category1 and2. Initialization covers all concrete N,D>=2 with the other seven fields zero, including N=D=3.

Halt has no successor obligation; counting its guard as enabled does not prove any actual halting execution. Rejecting exactly six abstract guards proves their concrete unreachability from the corresponding family, assuming the certificate checker passes.
